counterfactual_missing_items: no recent genitourinary or gastrointestinal infections
no history of psoriasis or uveitis
family history is notable for a maternal aunt with rheumatoid arthritis
decisive_items: symmetric pain in the small joints of her hands, wrists, knees, and ankles
anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody of 237.39 units (normal <20 units)
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it has multiple decisive items, including symmetric joint pain, elevated rheumatoid factor, and positive anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody, which are all consistent with Rheumatoid Arthritis. R4 is the runner-up because it has some supporting evidence, such as the recent COVID-19 infection, but it lacks the specific markers and symptoms that are present in R3.

rejected.why: lack of specific antibodies and symptoms for Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
elevated antinuclear antibody titer is not specific enough to diagnose Undifferentiated Connective Tissue Disease
